items.title: File Widerspruch against the Fahrtenbuchauflage
items.quote: Der Widerspruch muss binnen eines Monats, nachdem Ihnen der Bescheid bekannt gegeben worden ist, schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift beim Kreis Beispielförde, Kreishaus, Förder Straße 3, 24103 Beispielförde, erhoben werden.
items.computation: Letter dated Tue 29.09.2026. As an authority (Kreis) postal letter, it counts as delivered (bekanntgegeben) on the 4th day after posting per § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG, i.e. Sat 03.10.2026; this deemed-delivery day does not shift even though it is a Saturday/Tag der Deutschen Einheit for this type of rule. The one-month Widerspruch period then starts the next day (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB) and ends one month later, on Tue 03.11.2026 (§ 188 Abs. 1, 2 BGB), which is a normal business day so no further shift applies (§ 31 Abs. 3 VwVfG). Confirmed via the compute_deadline tool.

items.title: Fahrtenbuch obligation begins (Bestandskraft of the order)
items.quote: Die Auflage beginnt mit Eintritt der Bestandskraft dieses Bescheids.
items.computation: The six-month Fahrtenbuch duty starts only once the order becomes bestandskräftig (final/unchallengeable). If no Widerspruch is filed, that occurs the day after the Widerspruch period expires, i.e. the day after 03.11.2026 = 04.11.2026. This is contingent: filing a Widerspruch (even if later rejected) would push finality further out until the remedy is exhausted, so the exact start date cannot be fixed with certainty from this letter alone.

warnings: The Fahrtenbuch start date (and thus its 6-month end date) depends on the order becoming final (Bestandskraft); if a Widerspruch is filed, the start date will be later than the earliest-plausible 04.11.2026 shown here.
